{{Quote|My mission is to deliver recon on this village, but I can't report anything through this interference!|Blyes on his assignment to Drelliad village|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Jendan Blyes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mantellian Trooper]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] as part of the [[Mantellian Army]], and he fought against the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Glad you made it back in one piece! Me and my squad owe you one.|Blyes thanking the individual who destroyed the signal jammers|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Blyes.png|thumb|left|Jendan Blyes during the last year of the Cold War]]
Jendan Blyes was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic. He held the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] while deployed on the Republic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]], a civil war where Republic forces aided the corrupt local government in fighting the anti-Republic [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="TOR" />

At some point, the Separatists invaded [[Drelliad village]], a critical point between the Republic base of [[Fort Garnik]] and Separatist-controlled territory, so Blyes and his squad from the [[Thirty-first Recon]]<ref name="Blyes" /> were assigned to scout the settlement but were ultimately engaged by an organized Separatist force near the village's entrance. During the exchange of fire, the sergeant attempted to contact headquarters on Fort Garnik due to the Separatists use of [[Jammer/Legends|signal jammers]] within the village.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Due to this, Blyes was forced to ask a passing by Republic-aligned individual to disable the signal jammers in order to re-establish communications between his forward recon team and the other Republic forces in order to report the situation. Accepting this mission, the individual disabled the three signal jammers&mdash;as well as killing several Separatists&mdash;and returned to the Sergeant who awarded his rescuer with a weapon from his stock.
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Captain_Jendan_Blyes.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Captain Jendan Blyes]]
During his assignment to Drelliad village, Blyes wore blue armor and a matching ribbed helmet along with a pair of beige pants, standard to most Republic Army's soldiers stationed on Ord Mantell. He was armed with a dark blaster rifle which he kept strapped to his back when not in use.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blyes is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Nolan North]]. He is one of the first NPCs encountered by players of the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper]] or [[Voidhound|Smuggler]] class due to his location right next to the point at which each class starts when first created. It is impossible for players of the Imperial faction to interact with Blyes as there is currently no way Imperial characters can travel to Ord Mantell.<ref name="TOR" />
